remediation_units.title: Default Simulation Execution Path to Real Backend Engine
remediation_units.root_cause: LiveOperationsView.tsx initializes trainingMode='mock' and executes client-side synthetic Gaussian noise steps instead of triggering the operational backend PyTorch federated training engine.
remediation_units.required_change:
1. Change default trainingMode from 'mock' to 'real' in LiveOperationsView.tsx.
2. Ensure 'Start Simulation' button triggers useCreateSimulation mutation directly.
3. Connect charts to incoming WebSocket events from /ws/training.
4. Retain client-side simulation strictly behind an explicitly labeled 'Offline Sandbox Demo' toggle for zero-backend testing.
remediation_units.runtime_validation: Trigger simulation in UI, verify HTTP POST /api/v1/simulations is fired, verify PyTorch logs appear in backend console, verify WebSocket streams live training losses.

remediation_units.title: Decouple Live Telemetry WebSocket from Pure Random Generation
remediation_units.root_cause: /ws/telemetry runs an infinite loop generating transactions with random.choice and random.uniform while the UI claims 'Live WS'.
remediation_units.required_change:
1. In telemetry_websocket_endpoint, check if streaming connector (Kafka/Redis) is active. If active, stream real transactions.
2. If no streaming connector is active, emit event with metadata stream_type: 'synthetic_simulation'.
3. In Header.tsx, display 'Simulated Feed' instead of 'Live WS' when the stream is operating in synthetic mode.
remediation_units.runtime_validation: Connect to /ws/telemetry with and without Kafka, verify metadata stream_type is present and header badge reflects actual data source.

remediation_units.title: Replace Beta-Distribution Synthesis in Design Partner Service with Real Model Inference
remediation_units.root_cause: evaluate_reference_benchmark synthesizes prediction probabilities using Beta distributions rather than running PyTorch model forward pass.
remediation_units.required_change: Execute actual model inference on the sample feature matrix X using PyTorch weights to produce y_prob_fl and y_prob_local, calculating authentic ROC-AUC and PR-AUC.
remediation_units.runtime_validation: Run POST /api/v1/design-partner/benchmark, verify that prediction probabilities vary with model checkpoint weights and input features.

remediation_units.title: Sanitize Dashboard Comparative Baselines Crossover & Model Registry Fallbacks
remediation_units.root_cause: get_comparative_baselines reads offline benchmark files with static dictionary fallback; model_registry returns hardcoded champions if directory is unseeded.
remediation_units.required_change:
1. In get_comparative_baselines, aggregate comparisons from registered champion model evaluation logs; clearly label historical benchmark baselines as 'Benchmark Reference'.
2. In model_registry, return empty array when no models exist rather than fabricating static models.
remediation_units.runtime_validation: Verify GET /api/v1/models returns empty list on clean boot and populated list after training.

remediation_units.title: Gate Pre-Seeded Simulation 'sim_fed_01' Behind Explicit Reference Annotation
remediation_units.root_cause: _seed_canonical_simulation runs on module load, creating a static completed simulation that appears as a live past run.
remediation_units.required_change: Add metadata field is_canonical_reference: True to sim_fed_01 so UI renders it as 'Reference Benchmark Run (Read-Only)' rather than an active user execution.
remediation_units.runtime_validation: Query GET /api/v1/simulations/sim_fed_01 and verify is_canonical_reference is True and UI renders appropriate badge.

remediation_units.title: Make Storage Persistence Fallback and TEE Software Emulation Explicit in Health API and UI
remediation_units.root_cause: Redis failure silently switches to ephemeral in-memory storage; TEE driver simulates SGX attestation in software with sleep delays.
remediation_units.required_change:
1. In /api/v1/health, return storage_backend: 'redis' | 'in_memory_ephemeral'.
2. In TEEDriver, return hardware_type: 'SOFTWARE_EMULATED' unless /dev/sgx_enclave exists. Render 'Software Emulation' on SecurityPage.
remediation_units.runtime_validation: Check GET /api/v1/health and verify storage_backend is reported correctly.

remediation_units.title: Connect Technical Dossier Download to Evidence Registry API
remediation_units.root_cause: TechnicalReportModal generates JSON file from an in-memory literal object.
remediation_units.required_change: Wire download action to fetch authentic verified dossier from GET /api/v1/dashboard/evidence-dossier or static evidence registry.
remediation_units.runtime_validation: Click download in modal, verify file content matches verified evidence registry.

remediation_units.title: Align Launch Modals and Stream Fallback with Explicit Status Indicators
remediation_units.root_cause: PlatformLaunchModal has hardcoded 950ms timer; useRealTimeFraudStream auto-switches to client random generator.
remediation_units.required_change:
1. Query /api/v1/health during launch modal before transitioning.
2. In useRealTimeFraudStream, pause stream rather than generating random transactions unless user clicks 'Enable Offline Demo'.
remediation_units.runtime_validation: Verify launch modal verifies health and stream does not invent fake transactions on disconnect.
